text:
dina: Quick sync — inheritance + exceptions for quotas in the RBAC console. Right now tenant overrides silently win over role presets. We need a clear preview + an approval path for overrides that exceed org caps. Thoughts?

omar: Backend note: policy-eval merges role_template -> tenant_override -> binding_override -> org_cap. Adding per-binding overrides is ok but we should return a trace so UI can show lineage. API idea: POST /admin/permissions/preview (dry_run) -> returns effective_quota + trace + preview_id.

li: UX: show a compact "quota lineage" pill: role preset > tenant override > binding override > org cap. Tooltip explains each. In preview step show what changed and why (e.g., "effective quota capped by ORG_CAP"). Keep modal 3 steps max.

beth: Telemetry: emit permission_preview_shown (tags: org, num_overrides, blocked_by_org_cap=true|false, preview_latency_ms). Also permission_preview_result with counts. If user requests an exception emit exception_request_created (with preview_id).

audit-bot: Reminder: any exception or binding-commit must produce an immutable audit event with actor_id, preview_id, justification. Also store preview snapshots for repro.

dina: Inline reasons in preview for denied/adjusted routes: ORG_CAP, BILLING_LIMIT, ROUTE_POLICY_BLOCK. Helpful to show human text like "exceeds org monthly budget".

omar: Implementation caveat: merging is a bit heavy. We'll cache merged results for 5s and return cache_hit flag. If dry_run=true we'll not persist anything. Also include conflict codes for each route. Sample request (dry_run):```json
{
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "principal": "analytics@acme",
  "role": "quota-manager",
  "overrides": {"/v1/generate": 1000000},
  "dry_run": true
}
``` sample response fields: preview_id, effective_quotas:{...}, trace:[...], cache_hit:true, errors:[...].

li: UX for exceptions: when a user attempts an override that hits ORG_CAP show a small "Request exception" CTA in preview. Flow: user enters justification -> submit -> show pending state. Approver gets email + console task. Auto-deny after 72h if no response. Show TTL on approved exceptions.

beth: Metrics to watch during rollout: previews_per_org, avg_preview_latency, exception_rate, exception_approval_ratio. Also histograms for preview_latency_ms to catch regressions.

audit-bot: Note: preview snapshots retention must be >= 13 months for compliance. We'll store preview_id -> snapshot mapping but redact PII.

dina: Rollout plan: behind org-level feature flag. Phases: internal alpha -> pilot 5 customers -> staged ramp. Default disabled for orgs with strict retention rules until sec signs off.

omar: I'll open RFC (RFC-2150) for the preview endpoint + sampling guidance. Plan to add preview cache and a minimal preview payload to keep latency < 300ms for typical requests.

li: I'll mock the lineage pill + preview modal and show small diff +/- indicators. Also include a tiny "why" link that opens docs.

sec: Security/ops: confirm audit format and retention. Exceptions require approver SSO and 2FA. We'll document approval matrix. Also block wildcard overrides by default.

dina: Action items: omar RFC + endpoint, li mocks + copy, beth telemetry draft, sec audit + exception matrix, audit-bot to confirm retention policy. Sync Fri. :thumbsup:
